subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should OpenClaw add a global `cron.defaults.delivery` primary delivery recipient default, and how should it interact with `last`, `none`, explicit per-job delivery, and `cron.failureDestination`?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds a privacy-sensitive global recipient default and a new config surface, so automation should not choose the permanent policy.

options.title: Add Focused Cron Delivery Default
options.body: Add `cron.defaults.delivery` with strict precedence, target validation, docs, UI/CLI support, and tests while keeping failure notification defaults separate.

options.title: Reject New Config And Use Existing Paths
options.body: Do not add a new global recipient config and instead improve per-job creation, preserved origin routing, or doctor/UX guidance around explicit delivery.

options.title: Fold Into Broad Output Routing Design
options.body: Treat this as a subset of the broader cron output-target contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49078 and avoid a narrower config until that design is settled.

recommendation.title: Add Focused Cron Delivery Default
recommendation.body: Add `cron.defaults.delivery` with strict precedence, target validation, docs, UI/CLI support, and tests while keeping failure notification defaults separate.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing candidate from recent cron default work, current blame, and prior triage on this focused tracker.
